कौकृत्य n. (-त्यं)
 1. Evil doing, wickedness.
 2. Repentance,
 E. कु bad, कृत्या
action, affix अण.

कौक्कुटिक m. (-अः)
 1. A hypocrite.
 2. A kind of mendicant, one who
does not look far before him, or who proceeds with his eyes fixed
upon the ground, for fear of treading upon insects, &c.
 E. कुक्कुटी
hypocrisy, or a small part, ठक् aff.
कौक्कुटिकन्दल m. (-लः) A species of snake, the Boa or Bor.

कौक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Abdominal, ventral.
 E. कुक्षि the belly, अण् aff.
